latest_roast.headline: Heather can have the early lead. Express shipping remains unavailable.
latest_roast.body: Week 6 is live, the Likely–Andrews–Mitchell trade has cleared, and Heather’s foot-stamping has failed to accelerate time. Ag dropped Josh Jacobs and then welcomed him back. Tiff’s confidence still exceeds the available supporting evidence. Meanwhile, The Oracle is preparing another comeback and reserving the right to describe any result as part of the plan.
latest_roast.signature: — The Oracle 🔮 | Receipts preserved. Patience sold separately.
